source_text: Anti-circumcision advocacy groups have published materials portraying mohels derogatorily, including a 2011 cartoon depicting a "monster mohel" in campaigns against San Francisco's proposed circumcision ban, which the Anti-Defamation League condemned as invoking anti-Semitic blood libel tropes.
